endue.definition: v give qualities or abilities to
endue.translation: vt. 授予, 赋予, 穿上

enduing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Endue
enduing.translation: v. 授予, 赋予（特性、才能等）( endue的现在分词 )

endurable.definition: s capable of being borne though unpleasant
endurable.translation: a. 可忍受的, 能忍耐的

endurably.translation: adv. 可忍受地；能忍耐地；能持久地

endurance.definition: n. the power to withstand hardship or stress
endurance.translation:
n. 忍耐, 忍耐力, 耐性
[机] 持九性

endurance limit.translation: [化] 持久极限; 疲劳极限; 耐久强度

endurance riding.translation: [网络] 耐力赛；耐力赛骑乘

endurant.definition: a. Capable of enduring fatigue, pain, hunger, etc.
endurant.translation: a. 能忍耐的,能耐劳的

endure.definition:
v put up with something or somebody unpleasant
v face and withstand with courage
v continue to live through hardship or adversity
v undergo or be subjected to
v last and be usable
v persist for a specified period of time
v continue to exist
endure.translation:
vt. 忍受, 忍耐, 容忍, 耐
vi. (正式)持久, 持续
[计] 仍能工作, 继续工作

endured.translation:
a. 吃苦耐劳的
v. （长时间地）忍受, 忍耐, 容忍( endure的过去式和过去分词 ); 持续, 持久, 坚持下去

endures.definition:
v put up with something or somebody unpleasant
v face and withstand with courage
v continue to live through hardship or adversity
v undergo or be subjected to
v last and be usable
v persist for a specified period of time
v continue to exist
endures.translation: v. （长时间地）忍受, 忍耐, 容忍( endure的第三人称单数 ); 持续, 持久, 坚持下去

enduring.definition: s. patiently bearing continual wrongs or trouble
enduring.translation: a. 持久的, 忍耐的

enduringly.translation: adv. 耐久地, 永久地

enduringness.definition: n. permanence by virtue of the power to resist stress or force

enduro.translation: n. (汽车、摩托车等的)长距离(耐力)竞赛, 耐力跑
